参加医学或医疗健康主题的夏校，了解医学学习内容与职业路径，帮助确认申请方向并积累: Attend a summer school on a medical or healthcare theme, learn about the content of medical study and career pathways, and thereby help confirm the direction of your application and build up your background.
团队在数天内针对真实问题建立数学模型并撰写论文，锻炼应用数学、编程与协作，是数学: Over several days the team builds a mathematical model for a real problem and writes a paper, exercising applied mathematics, programming and collaboration; it is a practical highlight for mathematics/engineering pathways.
生物学竞赛训练，练习生命科学知识、数据分析与科学推理。: Biology olympiad training, practising life-science knowledge, data analysis and scientific reasoning.
面向中学生的化学竞赛，考查化学原理的深度理解与应用，适合目标化学、材料、医学等方: A chemistry competition for secondary school students, testing deep understanding and application of chemical principles, suitable for students aiming at chemistry, materials, medicine and related fields.
算法编程竞赛，练习算法设计、问题分析与程序实现。: Algorithmic programming contest, practising algorithm design, problem analysis and program implementation.
物理竞赛训练，练习物理建模、数量估算与多步骤推理。: Physics Olympiad training, practising physical modelling, order-of-magnitude estimation, and multi-step reasoning.
以研究报告形式参评，练习数学研究、论证与学术写作。: Submitted as a research report; practises mathematical research, argument and academic writing.
参加大学或机构举办的计算机主题夏校，接触大学层次的课程与项目，了解专业方向并提前: Attend a computer-themed summer school run by a university or institution, encounter university-level courses and projects, learn about the subject direction and experience the academic atmosphere in advance.
由剑桥大学经济学生组织举办的论文竞赛，考查经济学理解与分析写作，适合目标经济专业: An essay competition organised by a Cambridge University economics student society, testing economic understanding and analytical writing, suitable for students aiming for economics who want to demonstrate academic potential.
数学挑战与奥林匹克训练，练习解题、推理和证明。参赛资格以当届规则为准。: Mathematical challenges and olympiad training, practising problem-solving, reasoning and proof. Eligibility is subject to the rules of the current competition.
按各赛题安排: Arranged according to each competition question
高强度的数学研究型夏校，深入数论、代数等主题，适合数学热情强烈、希望冲击顶尖院校: An intensive mathematics research-oriented summer school that goes deep into topics such as number theory and algebra, suitable for students with a strong passion for mathematics who wish to aim for top universities.
秋季起逐轮晋级: Progression round by round from autumn
暑期，选拔竞争激烈: Summer, with fierce competition in selection
参加知名高校的经济或商科夏校，修读大学水平课程，提升学术背景并了解专业方向。: Attend a summer school in economics or business at a well-known university, take university-level courses, enhance your academic background and learn about the subject direction.
围绕数据集完成建模、验证和结果分析；参赛要求以各赛题规则为准。: Complete modelling, validation and analysis of results around the dataset; the competition requirements are governed by the rules of each problem.
全年，适合长期投入: Full year, suitable for long-term commitment
参加物理/化学/生物主题的大学夏校，修读进阶课程或参与实验项目，加深对专业方向的: Attend university summer schools in physics/chemistry/biology themes, take advanced courses or take part in laboratory projects, to deepen understanding of the subject direction.
参与开源项目，记录代码贡献、问题分析与协作过程。已有规划中的原始名称保持不变。: Take part in open-source projects, recording code contributions, problem analysis and the collaboration process. Keep the original names already in the plan unchanged.
分级算法竞赛，练习数据结构、算法设计与程序实现。: Tiered algorithm competitions, practising data structures, algorithm design and program implementation.
围绕一个感兴趣的经济现象做独立研究并撰写论文，可在导师指导下完成，体现研究方法与: Conduct independent research on an economic phenomenon of interest and write a dissertation, which may be completed under a supervisor's guidance, demonstrating research methods and academic depth.
通常暑期截稿，建议提前数月准备: Usually the deadline is in the summer; it is advisable to prepare several months in advance
全年多场，建议尽早开始: Several sessions throughout the year; it is advisable to start as early as possible
每年一届，需长期准备: Held once a year; requires long-term preparation
参与生物医学相关的研究或课题，展现对医学科学的兴趣与研究能力，为申请增添学术深度: Participate in biomedical-related research or projects, demonstrating an interest in and research ability in medical science, adding academic depth to the application.
学术论文竞赛，练习独立思辨、资料分析与论证写作。: Academic essay competitions, practising independent critical thinking, source analysis and argumentative writing.
团队形式的经济学知识竞赛，涵盖微观、宏观与时事，适合系统巩固经济学基础、锻炼团队: A team-format economics knowledge competition covering microeconomics, macroeconomics and current affairs, suitable for systematically consolidating the foundations of economics and developing teamwork.
在高校或研究机构参与科研项目、实验或课题，积累真实的科学研究经历，是理工方向文书: Participating in research projects, experiments or topics at universities or research institutions and accumulating genuine scientific research experience is strong material for personal statements in STEM fields.
